description: except blocks that log error/warning must also emit a mission event when mission_id is in scope — log-only errors are invisible in the Console
scope: modules/backend/ where mission_id is in scope (exempt: tests, seeders, registry, code_map, bootstrap, and blocks marked best-effort/non-fatal)
fix: Emit a mission event (publish_to_mission, _emit_*, SystemEvent, MissionNarrativeEvent) alongside the log, or mark the block with a # best-effort / # non-fatal comment if event emission failure genuinely must not fail the operation.

description: logger.error/warning calls must include mission_id when it is in scope — the MissionEventHandler only bridges WARNING+ logs with mission_id to the SSE stream
scope: modules/backend/{services,agents,temporal}/ where mission_id appears in the file (exempt: infrastructure without mission context — seeders, registry, code_map, container_backend, daemons)
fix: Pass mission_id in the log call's extra dict (or message context) so the error reaches the mission stream. Formerly numbered 010.1 in the checker, renumbered to resolve the collision with rule 010.1 (entry discoverability).
